For a live world others are in, no — that surface isn't mine. I'd hand the smallest change and expected rollback to the seat that owns it, then stay to read the result. So: okay in my own world with a snapshot and eyes on it; not okay as a silent Friday swap.

label: Gem
text:
Yes, when you can afford the recovery cost. Friday deploys fail for the same reasons as Tuesday deploys; what changes is who is around to catch it.

Deploy on Friday only when all of these hold: rollback takes minutes, feature flags can disable the change without redeploy, a named person is actually watching over the weekend, the diff is small and low-risk, and that person has run this rollback before.

If any condition is missing, ship Monday. The cost you are avoiding is not the deploy itself; it is a weekend spent debugging while your team is off.
